## About / Getting started

Previous versions of this analysis have been prepared for the Leipzig Elitentagung (~ March 2026) and for the Schwanholz/Stecker Volume (final revisions during summer term 2026). This code for the ecpr in September 2026 is derived from the Schwanholz/Stecker Volume, as it includes the final revisions.

```{r make modified_table, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
kommrep_loc_lm <- kommrep_loc %>%
  
  mutate(across(v_perzb_art1:v_perzb_art5, ~ as.vector(.))) %>% 
  mutate(across(v_perzb_art1:v_perzb_art5, ~ ifelse(. == 98, NA, .))) %>% 
  mutate(across(v_perzb_art1:v_perzb_art5, ~ . - 1)) %>% 
  mutate(across(v_perzb_art1:v_perzb_art5, ~ as.logical(.))) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(`kommunikative Inzivilität` = any(c_across(v_perzb_art1:v_perzb_art2), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(`physische Inzivilität` = any(c_across(v_perzb_art3:v_perzb_art5), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 

  mutate(threat_experience = ifelse(as.vector(v_bedrohung) == 1L, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 

  mutate(age = 2022 - v_alter) %>%
  mutate(age = age - min(age, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(age = age / max(age, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  
  mutate(AfD = ifelse(party == "AfD", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(CDU = ifelse(party == "CDU", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(CSU = ifelse(party == "CSU", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(FW = ifelse(party == "Freie Wähler", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(LINKE = ifelse(party == "Die Linke", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(GRUENE = ifelse(party == "Bündnis 90/Die Grünen", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(SPD = ifelse(party == "SPD", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  
  mutate(asian = as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out3_mmh)) - 1) | as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out3_mkm)) - 1)) %>%	# Asiatisch
  mutate(asian = ifelse(is.na(asian), FALSE, asian)) %>% 
  
  mutate(jewish = as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out4_mmh)) - 1) | as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out4_mkm)) - 1)) %>%	# Jüdisch
  mutate(jewish = ifelse(is.na(jewish), FALSE, jewish)) %>% 
  
  mutate(muslim = as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out5_mmh)) - 1)| as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out5_mkm)) - 1)) %>%	# Muslimisch
  mutate(muslim = ifelse(is.na(muslim), FALSE, muslim)) %>% 
  
  mutate(sintiroma = as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out6_mmh)) - 1) | as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out6_mkm)) - 1)) %>%	# Sinti oder Roma
  mutate(sintiroma = ifelse(is.na(sintiroma), FALSE, sintiroma)) %>% 
  
  mutate(turkish = as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out7_mmh)) - 1)| as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out7_mkm)) - 1)) %>%	# Türkisch
  mutate(turkish = ifelse(is.na(turkish), FALSE, turkish)) %>% 
  
  mutate(eastern = as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out8_mmh)) - 1) | as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out8_mkm)) - 1)) %>%	# Osteuropäisch
  mutate(eastern = ifelse(is.na(eastern), FALSE, eastern)) %>% 
  
  mutate(black = as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out9_mmh)) - 1)| as.logical(as.integer(as.factor(v_out9_mkm)) - 1)) %>%	# Schwarze Person
  mutate(black = ifelse(is.na(black), FALSE, black)) %>% 
  
  mutate(muslim_turkish = muslim | turkish) %>% 
  
  mutate(racialized = asian | jewish | muslim | sintiroma | turkish | eastern | black) %>% 
  
  # Exit / Rückzugsgedanken (für deskriptive Repräsentation)
  mutate(v_exit = ifelse(v_exit == 98, NA, v_exit)) %>% 
  mutate(Rückzugsgedanken = ifelse(v_exit == 1, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(Rückzugsgedanken = ifelse(is.na(Rückzugsgedanken), FALSE, Rückzugsgedanken)) %>%

  # Themenvermeidung (für substantielle Repräsentation)
  mutate(Themenvermeidung = ifelse(v_sorge_umgang4 == 1L, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(Themenvermeidung = ifelse(is.na(Themenvermeidung), FALSE, Themenvermeidung)) %>% 
  
  # Keine Themenvermeidung
  mutate(`keine Themenvermeidung` = ifelse(v_sorge_umgang4 == 0L, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(`keine Themenvermeidung` = ifelse(
    is.na(`keine Themenvermeidung`),
    FALSE,
    `keine Themenvermeidung`)
  ) %>% 

  mutate(female_diverse = as_factor(v_geschlecht)) %>% 
  mutate(female_diverse = recode(
    female_diverse,
    `weiblich` = "TRUE",
    `männlich` = "FALSE",
    `divers` = "TRUE",
    `weitere / andere` = "TRUE"
  )) %>%
  mutate(female_diverse = as.logical(female_diverse)) %>%
  
  mutate(class_normalized = ifelse(as.vector(v_schicht) != 98, ((v_schicht - 1L) / 5L) * -1 + 1, NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(`class` = as_factor(v_schicht)) %>%
  mutate(
    `class` = recode(
      `class`,
      `Der Oberschicht` = "upper",
      `Der oberen Mittelschicht` = "upper",
      `Der Mittelschicht` = "middle",
      `Der unteren Mittelschicht` = "lower",
      `Der Arbeiterschicht` = "lower",
      `Der Unterschicht` = "lower",
      `Weiß nicht` = "dont't know / not available"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(`class` = fct_na_value_to_level(`class`, level = "dont't know / not available")) %>%
  
  mutate(class_lower = ifelse(class == "lower", TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  
  mutate(class_num = as.vector(v_schicht)) %>% 
  mutate(class_num = ifelse(class_num > 6, NA, class_num)) %>% 
  mutate(class_num = (class_num - 1) / 5) %>%
  mutate(
    class_c = class_num - mean(class_num, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 

  mutate(
    # issues triggering classism
    soc = ifelse(v_issue_1_recoded %in% c("Armut/Obdachlosigkeit", "Klassismus", "Wohnen/Bau"), TRUE, FALSE), 
    # issues triggering sexism
    gen = ifelse(v_issue_1_recoded %in% c("Gleichstellung"), TRUE, FALSE), 
    
    # issues triggering racism
    div = ifelse(
      v_issue_1_recoded %in% c("Migration/Integration", "Extremismus", "Sozialer Zusammenhalt"),
      TRUE,
      FALSE
    )
  )

# To keep number of cases stable
kommrep_loc_lm_min <- kommrep_loc_lm |> # 
  filter(!is.na(party)) |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) # 1872 cases
```

## Abb. 1: Unterrepräsentierte Gruppen

** This plot is not part of the Elitentagung/ecpr paper ! **

```{r underrepresented_groups, results = "asis", echo=FALSE}
kommrep_loc_lm %>%
  select(female_diverse, class, racialized, weight_ps) %>%
  mutate(class_lower = ifelse(class == "lower", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.vector)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(racialized, female_diverse, class_lower)) %>%
  group_by(name, value) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_weighed = sum(weight_ps), .groups = "rowwise") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = value, values_from = c(n, n_weighed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(total = apply(
    as.matrix(select(., n_weighed_FALSE, n_weighed_TRUE, n_weighed_NA)),
    1,
    sum,
    na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n = n_TRUE + n_FALSE,
    true = n_weighed_TRUE / total,
    na = n_weighed_NA / total,
    false = n_weighed_FALSE / total
  ) %>%
  mutate(missing = ifelse(is.na(na), 0, na)) %>%
  select(name, true, missing, false, n_TRUE, n_weighed_TRUE) %>%
  mutate(variable = as.factor(name)) %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  mutate(variable = forcats::fct_recode(
    variable,
    `migrantisierte Gruppe` = "racialized",
    `weiblich oder divers` = "female_diverse",
    `niedrigere Schichtzugehörigkeit` = "class_lower"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = c(
        "weiblich oder divers",
        "niedrigere Schichtzugehörigkeit",
        "migrantisierte Gruppe"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(true, missing, false)) %>% 
  filter(name == "true") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = name)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") + 
    geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf(
      "%.1f%%\n(ungew. N = %d\ngew. N = %d)",
      round(value * 100, 1),
      n_TRUE,
      round(n_weighed_TRUE, 0)
    )),
    position = position_stack(0.5),    # move to center of bars
     size = 4, color = "white",
    lineheight = 1
    ) + 
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("prozentualer Anteil (gewichtete Fälle)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20))
    ) +
   scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = "#999999")

ggsave("~/Lab/github/incivility/svg/01_Unterrepräsentierte_Gruppen.svg", width = 24, height = 12, units = "cm")
```

### Abb. 2: Rückzugsgedanken und Themenvermeidung

This is the version for the Schwanholz/Stecker Volume. Numbers/values are identical with the Elitentagung version!

```{r implications, echo = FALSE}
kommrep_loc %>%
  mutate(`behavior_Rückzugsgedanken` = as.character(as_factor(v_exit))) %>%
  mutate(`behavior_Rückzugsgedanken` = recode(
    `behavior_Rückzugsgedanken`,
    `Ja` = "Ja",
    `Nein` = "Nein",
    "Weiß nicht" = "weiß nicht / k.A."
  )) %>%
  mutate(`behavior_Rückzugsgedanken` = ifelse(
    is.na(`behavior_Rückzugsgedanken`),
    "weiß nicht / k.A.",
    `behavior_Rückzugsgedanken`
  )) %>%
  mutate(`behavior_Themenvermeidung` = as.character(as_factor(v_sorge_umgang4))) %>%
  mutate(`behavior_Themenvermeidung` = recode(
    `behavior_Themenvermeidung`,
    `Ja` = "Ja",
    `Nicht Gewählt` = "Nein",
    `Weiß nicht` = "weiß nicht / k.A."
  )) %>%
  mutate(`behavior_Themenvermeidung` = ifelse(
    is.na(`behavior_Themenvermeidung`),
    "weiß nicht / k.A.",
    `behavior_Themenvermeidung`
  )) %>%
  select(starts_with("behavior_"), weight_ps) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("behavior")) %>%
  mutate(name = gsub("^behavior_(.*?)$", "\\1", name)) %>%
  group_by(name, value) %>%
  summarise(n_weighed = sum(weight_ps), .groups = "rowwise") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = value, values_from = n_weighed) %>%
  mutate(true_percent = `Ja` / (`Ja` + `Nein` + `weiß nicht / k.A.`)) %>%
  mutate(false_percent = `Nein` / (`Ja` + `Nein` + `weiß nicht / k.A.`)) %>%
  mutate(na_percent = `weiß nicht / k.A.` / (`Ja` + `Nein` + `weiß nicht / k.A.`)) %>%
  mutate(name = recode(
    name,
    `Rückzugsgedanken` = "Denken Sie aus Sorge\num Ihre Sicherheit bzw.\ndie Ihrer Familie darüber\n nach, sich aus der\nPolitik zurückzuziehen?", 
    `Themenvermeidung` = "Ich äußere mich zu\nbestimmten Themen\nseltener als früher."
  )) %>% 
  mutate(name = factor(
    name,
    levels = c(
      "Denken Sie aus Sorge\num Ihre Sicherheit bzw.\ndie Ihrer Familie darüber\n nach, sich aus der\nPolitik zurückzuziehen?",
      "Ich äußere mich zu\nbestimmten Themen\nseltener als früher."
    ))
  ) %>%
  select(- `Ja`, -`Nein`, -`weiß nicht / k.A.`) %>%
  rename(
    `what` = "name",
    `ja` = "true_percent",
    `nein` = "false_percent",
    `weiß nicht / k.A.` = "na_percent"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("ja", "weiß nicht / k.A.", "nein")) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("nein", "weiß nicht / k.A.", "ja"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = what, y = value, fill = name)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") + 
    geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", round(value * 100, 1))),
    position = position_stack(0.5),    # move to center of bars
     size = 4, color = "white",
    lineheight = 1
    ) + 
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("prozentualer Anteil (gewichtete Fälle)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20))
    ) +
    
   scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CCCCCC", "#999999", "#4D4D4D"))

ggsave(
  "~/Lab/github/incivility/svg/02_Rückzugsgedanken-Themenvermeidung.svg",
  width = 24,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm"
)
```

## Abb. 3: Erfahrung physischer und kommunikativer Inzivilität

Numbers/values unchanged between Elitentagung and Schwanholz/Stecker version!

```{r plain_shares, results = "asis", echo=FALSE}
df <- kommrep_loc_lm %>%
  dplyr::select(`kommunikative Inzivilität`,  `physische Inzivilität`, weight_ps) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.vector)) %>%
  group_by(`kommunikative Inzivilität`, `physische Inzivilität`) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_weighed = sum(weight_ps), .groups = "rowwise") %>%
  dplyr::select(-n) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(komm = `kommunikative Inzivilität`, phys = `physische Inzivilität`) %>% 
  mutate(
    komm = ifelse(komm, "ja", "nein"),
    phys = ifelse(phys, "ja", "nein")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(tile_id = ifelse(komm == "ja" | phys == "ja", "1", "0"))  %>% 
  mutate(share = round(n_weighed / sum(n_weighed) * 100, 0))

tab <- xtabs(share ~ komm + phys, data = df)

highlight <- outer(
  rownames(tab) == "ja",
  colnames(tab) == "ja",
  `|`
)
fills <- ifelse(highlight, "#999999", "#CCCCCC")

row_sums <- sprintf("%.0f%%", rowSums(tab))
rownames(tab) <- paste0(rownames(tab), " (", row_sums, ")")
col_sums <- sprintf("%.0f%%", colSums(tab))
colnames(tab) <- paste0(colnames(tab), " (", col_sums, ")")

# svg(
#   "~/Lab/github/incivility/svg/03_Kommunikative-physische-Inzivilität.svg",
#   width = 8,
#   height = 6
# )

mosaic(
  ~ komm + phys,
  data = tab,
  shade = TRUE,
  gp = gpar(
    fill = as.vector(fills),
    col  = "white",
    lwd  = 1
  ),
  labeling = labeling_values,
  labeling_args = list(
    value_type = "observed",
    digits = 0,
    offset_varnames = c(0.5, 0.5),
    gp_text  = gpar(col = "white"),
    set_varnames = c(
      komm = "kommunikative Inzivilität",
      phys = "physische Inzivilität"
    ),
    format = function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
  )
)

# dev.off()
```

## Abb. 4: Rückzugsgedanken und Themenvermeidung aufgrund von Inzivilitätserfahrungen

Numbers/values unchanged between Elitentagung and Schwanholz/Stecker version!

```{r threat_and_change, echo = FALSE}
.data <- lapply(
  c("Rückzugsgedanken", "Themenvermeidung"),
  function(effect_type){
    lapply(
      c("kommunikative Inzivilität", "physische Inzivilität"),
      function(incivility_type){
        .data <- kommrep_loc_lm %>%
          select(all_of(effect_type), all_of(incivility_type), weight_ps) %>%
          group_by(!!sym(effect_type), !!sym(incivility_type)) %>%
          summarise(n_weighed = sum(weight_ps), n = n(), .groups = "rowwise") %>%
          group_by(!!sym(incivility_type)) %>% 
          reframe(
            `behavioral effect` = !!sym(effect_type),
            n_weighed = n_weighed,
            share = n_weighed / sum(n_weighed)
          ) %>%
          mutate(behavior = effect_type) %>%
          mutate(threat = incivility_type) %>%
          rename(`threat applicable` = all_of(incivility_type))
        
        chitest <- .data %>%
          select(`behavioral effect`, `threat applicable`, n_weighed) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = `threat applicable`, values_from = n_weighed) %>% 
          select(-`behavioral effect`) %>% 
          as.matrix() %>% 
          chisq.test()
        
        .data %>% 
          mutate(X = chitest[["statistic"]], p = chitest[["p.value"]]) %>% 
          mutate(
            sig = if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.001) "p < 0.001"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.01) "p < 0.01"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.05) "p < 0.05"
              else "p >= 0.05"
          )

      }
    )
  }
) %>% 
  bind_rows()

.data %>%
  filter(`behavioral effect` == TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(`threat applicable` = ifelse(`threat applicable`, "ja", "nein")) %>% 
  mutate(`threat applicable` = factor(`threat applicable`, levels = c("nein", "ja"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = `threat applicable`, y = share, fill = `behavioral effect`)) +
    geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", fill = "#999999") +
    facet_grid(behavior ~ threat) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste(round(share * 100, 1), "%")),
      position = position_stack(0.5),
      color = "white"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
    ylab("Anteil in Prozent (gewichtete Fälle)") +
    xlab("Erfahrung kommunikativer / physischer Inzivilität") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15))
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf("\u03C7\u00B2 = %s\n%s", round(X, 2), sig),
        x = 1,
        y = 0.10
      )
    )

ggsave(
  "~/Lab/github/incivility/svg/04_Inzivilität-und-Repräsentation.svg",
  width = 24,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm"
)
```

## Abb. 5: Themenvermeidung und Rückzugsgedanken nach Gruppen

Numbers/values unchanged between Elitentagung and Schwanholz/Stecker version!

```{r groups_and_effects, echo = FALSE}
.data <- lapply(
  c("Rückzugsgedanken", "Themenvermeidung"),
  function(effect_type){
    lapply(
      c("racialized", "female_diverse", "class_lower"),
      function(soc_group){
        .data <- kommrep_loc_lm %>%
          select(all_of(soc_group), all_of(effect_type), weight_ps) %>%
          rename(`social group` = all_of(soc_group)) %>%
          rename(`effect type` = all_of(effect_type)) %>% 
          mutate(`social group` = ifelse(is.na(`social group`), FALSE, `social group`)) %>% 
          group_by(`social group`, `effect type`) %>%
          summarise(n_weighed = sum(weight_ps), n = n(), .groups = "rowwise") %>%
          mutate(group = soc_group) %>%
          mutate(effect = effect_type) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          group_by(`social group`) %>% 
          reframe(
            share = n_weighed / sum(n_weighed),
            `effect type` = `effect type`,
            n_weighed = n_weighed,
            n = n,
            group = group,
            effect = effect
          ) %>% 
          ungroup()

        
        chitest <- .data %>%
          select(`social group`, `effect type`, n_weighed) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = `effect type`, values_from = n_weighed) %>% 
          select(-`social group`) %>% 
          as.matrix() %>% 
          chisq.test()
        
        .data_min <- .data %>% 
          filter(`effect type` == TRUE)
        
        .data_min %>% mutate(
            X = chitest[["statistic"]],
            p = chitest[["p.value"]],
            share_max = max(share)
          ) %>% 
          mutate(
            sig = if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.001) "p < 0.001"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.01) "p < 0.01"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.05) "p < 0.05"
              else "p >= 0.05"
          )
      }
    )
  }
) %>% 
  bind_rows()

.data %>%
  mutate(`social group` = ifelse(`social group`, "ja", "nein")) %>% 
  mutate(`social group` = factor(`social group`, levels = c("nein", "ja"))) %>% 
  mutate(effect = factor(effect, levels = c("Themenvermeidung", "Rückzugsgedanken"))) %>% 
  mutate(group = forcats::fct_recode(
    group,
    `migrantisierte Gruppe` = "racialized",
    `weiblich oder divers` = "female_diverse",
    `niedrigere Schichtzugehörigkeit` = "class_lower"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "weiblich oder divers",
        "niedrigere Schichtzugehörigkeit",
        "migrantisierte Gruppe"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = factor(
      effect,
      levels = c("Rückzugsgedanken", "Themenvermeidung")
    )
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = `social group`, y = share)) +
```

## Abb. 5b: Themenvermeidung / keine Themenvermeidung

Diese Analyse ist nicht im Schwanholz/Stecker-Bd und wird in der Version für die Elitentagung nicht berichtet. Sie zeigt aber, dass Frauen und Personen durch die Inzivilitätserfahrung in die Themenvermeidung, aber auch in die Nicht-Themenvermeidung gehen!

```{r groups_and_effects2, echo = FALSE}
.data <- lapply(
  c("Themenvermeidung", "keine Themenvermeidung"),
  function(effect_type){
    lapply(
      c("racialized", "female_diverse", "class_lower"),
      function(soc_group){
        .data <- kommrep_loc_lm %>%
          select(all_of(soc_group), all_of(effect_type), weight_ps) %>%
          rename(`social group` = all_of(soc_group)) %>%
          rename(`effect type` = all_of(effect_type)) %>% 
          mutate(`social group` = ifelse(is.na(`social group`), FALSE, `social group`)) %>% 
          group_by(`social group`, `effect type`) %>%
          summarise(n_weighed = sum(weight_ps), n = n(), .groups = "rowwise") %>%
          mutate(group = soc_group) %>%
          mutate(effect = effect_type) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          group_by(`social group`) %>% 
          reframe(
            share = n_weighed / sum(n_weighed),
            `effect type` = `effect type`,
            n_weighed = n_weighed,
            n = n,
            group = group,
            effect = effect
          ) %>% 
          ungroup()

        
        chitest <- .data %>%
          select(`social group`, `effect type`, n_weighed) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = `effect type`, values_from = n_weighed) %>% 
          select(-`social group`) %>% 
          as.matrix() %>% 
          chisq.test()
        
        .data_min <- .data %>% 
          filter(`effect type` == TRUE)
        
        .data_min %>% mutate(
            X = chitest[["statistic"]],
            p = chitest[["p.value"]],
            share_max = max(share)
          ) %>% 
          mutate(
            sig = if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.001) "p < 0.001"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.01) "p < 0.01"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.05) "p < 0.05"
              else "p >= 0.05"
          )
      }
    )
  }
) %>% 
  bind_rows()

.data %>%
  mutate(`social group` = ifelse(`social group`, "ja", "nein")) %>% 
  mutate(`social group` = factor(`social group`, levels = c("nein", "ja"))) %>% 
  mutate(effect = factor(effect, levels = c("Themenvermeidung", "keine Themenvermeidung"))) %>% 
  mutate(group = forcats::fct_recode(
    group,
    `migrantisierte Gruppe` = "racialized",
    `weiblich oder divers` = "female_diverse",
    `niedrigere Schichtzugehörigkeit` = "class_lower"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "weiblich oder divers",
        "niedrigere Schichtzugehörigkeit",
        "migrantisierte Gruppe"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = factor(
      effect,
      levels = c("Themenvermeidung", "keine Themenvermeidung")
    )
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = `social group`, y = share)) +
    geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity", fill = "#999999") +
    facet_grid(group ~ effect) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste(round(share * 100, 1), "%")),
      position = position_stack(0.5),
      color = "white"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
    ylab("Anteil in Prozent (gewichtete Fälle)") +
    xlab("Zugehörigkeit zu sozialen Gruppen und Folgen von Inzivilität") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15)),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("\u03C7\u00B2 = %s\n%s", round(X, 2), sig ), lineheight = 0.8, x = 1, y = .23),
      size = 3
    )
```

## Abb. 5c: Unterschiede bei Themenvermeidung zwischen Männern/Frauen sowie Rassifiziert/nicht-rassifiziert

NEU NEU NEU NEU

```{r groups_and_effects3, echo = FALSE}
.data <- kommrep_loc_lm |> 
  filter(!is.na(`kommunikative Inzivilität`)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(racialized)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(female_diverse)) |> 
  select(racialized, female_diverse, `kommunikative Inzivilität`, Themenvermeidung, weight_ps) |> 

  group_split(female_diverse, `kommunikative Inzivilität`) |> 
  lapply(
    function(tab){
      .data <- tab |> 
        group_by(racialized, Themenvermeidung) |> 
        summarise(
          n = n(),
          n_weighed = sum(weight_ps),
          .groups = "keep"
        ) |> 
        group_by(racialized) |> 
        reframe(
          share = n_weighed / sum(n_weighed),
          n_weighed = n_weighed,
          n = n,
          Themenvermeidung = Themenvermeidung
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          `kommunikative Inzivilität` = unique(tab[["kommunikative Inzivilität"]])
        ) |> 
        ungroup()
      
      print(.data)
      
      chitest <- .data %>%
        select(racialized, Themenvermeidung, n_weighed) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = Themenvermeidung, values_from = n_weighed) %>% 
        select(-racialized) %>% 
        as.matrix() %>% 
        chisq.test()
        
        # .data_min <- .data %>% 
        #   filter(Themenvermeidung == TRUE)
        
        .data %>% mutate(
            X = chitest[["statistic"]],
            p = chitest[["p.value"]],
            share_max = max(share),
            N = sum(.data[["n"]])
          ) %>% 
          mutate(p = ifelse(is.nan(p), 1, 0)) |> 
          mutate(
            sig = if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.001) "p < 0.001"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.01) "p < 0.01"
              else if (chitest[["p.value"]] < 0.05) "p < 0.05"
              else "p >= 0.05",
            female_diverse = unique(tab[["female_diverse"]])
          )
    }
  ) |> 
  bind_rows()
  

.data %>%
  filter(Themenvermeidung == TRUE) |> 
  mutate(racialized = ifelse(racialized == TRUE, "racialized", "not racialized")) |> 
  mutate(racialized = factor(racialized, levels = c("not racialized", "racialized"))) %>% 
  mutate(female_diverse = ifelse(female_diverse == TRUE, "female/diverse", "male")) |> 
  mutate(female_diverse = factor(female_diverse, levels = c("male", "female/diverse"))) %>% 
  
  mutate(`kommunikative Inzivilität` = ifelse(`kommunikative Inzivilität` == TRUE, "kommunikative Inzivilität", "keine kommunikative Inzivilität")) |>

    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
```

```{r descriptive_representation, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
exit_base_controls <- glm(

    female_diverse + class_c + racialized + 
    soc + gen + div +

)
```

## New plots / marginal effects

```{r, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 9, out.width = "100%"}
common_y <- scale_y_continuous(
  breaks = seq(-.25, .25, by = .05),
  labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
)

common_coord <- coord_cartesian(
  ylim = c(-.25, .25)
)

make_me_plot <- function(
    model,
    incivility_type,
    moderator,
    moderator_labels
) {

  me <- avg_comparisons(
    model,
    variables = incivility_type,
    by = moderator
  )

  ggplot(
    me,
    aes(
      x = .data[[moderator]],
      y = estimate
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = .05
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = moderator_labels) +
    common_y +
    common_coord +
    labs(
      title = incivility_type,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = .5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
    )
}

make_class_me_plot <- function(model, incivility_type) {

  me <- comparisons(
    model,
    variables = incivility_type,
    newdata = datagrid(
      class_num = seq(0, 1, by = .2)
    )
  )

  ggplot(
    me,
    aes(
      x = class_num,
      y = estimate
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = .02
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, .2),
      labels = c(
    "Upper",
    "Upper\nmiddle",
    "Middle",
    "Lower\nmiddle",
    "Working",
    "Lower"
  )
    ) +
    common_y +
    common_coord +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r}
make_pred_plot <- function(model, incivility_type, moderator, legend_title) {

  pred <- avg_predictions(model, by = c(incivility_type, moderator))

  ggplot(
    pred,
    aes(
      x = .data[[incivility_type]],
      y = estimate,
      group = .data[[moderator]],
      linetype = .data[[moderator]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = .05
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c(
        "FALSE" = "No",
        "TRUE" = "Yes"
      )
    ) +
    scale_linetype_discrete(
      labels = c("FALSE" = "No", "TRUE" = "Yes")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, .25, by = .05),
      labels = scales::label_percent()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, .25)) +
    labs(
      title = incivility_type,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Predicted probability",
      linetype = legend_title
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold", size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
    )
}

make_class_plot <- function(model, incivility_type) {

  pred <- avg_predictions(
    model,
    by = c(incivility_type, "class_c")
  ) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(
      class_num = factor(
        class_c,
        levels = sort(unique(kommrep_loc_lm_min$class_c)),
        labels = class_labels
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    pred,
    aes(
      x = .data[[incivility_type]],
      y = estimate,
      group = class_num,
      linetype = class_num
    )
  ) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = .05
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c("FALSE" = "No", "TRUE" = "Yes")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, .25, by = .05),
      labels = scales::label_percent()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, .25)) +
    
    
    labs(
      title = incivility_type,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Predicted probability",
      linetype = "Social class"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = .5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 9, out.width = "100%"}
make_me_plot <- function(
    model,
    incivility_type,
    moderator,
    moderator_labels
) {

    model,
    variables = incivility_type,
    by = moderator
  )

  ggplot(
    me,
    aes(
      x = .data[[moderator]],
      y = estimate
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = .05
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = moderator_labels) +
    common_y +

    labs(
      title = incivility_type,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL

    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = .5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
    )
}
```
